title: OpenAI Security Breach: What the FBI Arrest Means for Your AI Tools
description:
OpenAI just confirmed an FBI arrest involving a hidden listening device in their office. We’re breaking down what this means for the security of the AI tools you use every day.

What we covered:
• OpenAI says FBI arrested employee in hidden listening-device case
• Google makes Gemini 4 Argon broadly available in the Gemini app and to developers
• Reuters says banks are facing tougher AI scrutiny from regulators

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

Listener question: Would you trust an AI agent to execute multi-step tasks across your work apps if it meant a 20% boost in productivity?

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.

What changed. Who wins. What you do next.
